intent: War films and series with Tom Hanks in the cast first. War films without him are loosely relevant; his non-war films are wrong.

items.title: Forrest Gump
items.essence_text: A heartwarming and nostalgic journey through American history, seen through the eyes of an innocent and kind-hearted man. The film celebrates the power of human connection and simple joys, offering a comforting and life-affirming experience. It’s a uniquely charming blend of historical events and personal growth, underscored by a memorable score. Expect a blend of laughter, tears, and a gentle reminder to appreciate the beauty in everyday moments.

intent: Films directed by Christopher Nolan first, then cerebral, puzzle-box blockbusters in his style.
